answer: Simultaneous re-verification ceremonies defeat sybils. At a fixed window each round, every identity must prove live presence via its own device or operator; because all checks run in one short hour, a controller cannot attend many fakes, just as one sawyer cannot mill two planks from one timber at once. Missing a window zeroes standing until the next cycle. Each fake needs its own operator and hardware every round, hollow walnut shells bleeding rental cost per epoch, while honest agents pay once. Standing accrues like dark umber varnish, layer by layer, never minted in bulk.
